messages:
Maya Patel: Taking over primary for the midday window. Leaving a quick handoff: pager active for ~10m, suspected latency spike on /v1/generate. I have the bridge open.
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: HIGH_LATENCY on /v1/generate — triggered 3 minutes ago. Pager sent to @primary-oncall. Severity: P2. Links: https://pager.redwood.example/INC-8243
Samir Khan: on it. Can you paste the last few tail logs from inference-prod so I can see errors or backpressure?
Maya Patel: tailing now — past 2m shows 503s from runtime and queue wait climbing. snippet:
```
2026-03-14T15:08:12Z runtime: accept request id=abc123 latency=120ms
2026-03-14T15:09:05Z runtime: accept request id=abc124 latency=9800ms queue_wait=8600ms
2026-03-14T15:09:06Z frontend: downstream error 503 id=abc124
```
Ravi Gupta: Looks like a bad batching knee — queue wait spiking. Is Dedicated pool autoscaler healthy? Check GPU utilization and OOMs.
Maya Patel: Autoscaler shows one scaling event 8m ago, but no new workers came up. GPU mem healthy, but new pods stuck in Pending due to node selector mismatch in the latest deploy.
Lin Zhao: note — APAC reserve nodes were temporarily cordoned for maintenance earlier. That could reduce headroom. I'm re-checking node labels.
Samir Khan: If pods are Pending, we should fallback routing to the smaller-quantized model variant to relieve load. Maya, can you flip the live routing policy to allow model-quant-v2 as fallback? It's in the runbook.
Maya Patel: Doing the routing change now — using console quick toggle. Command I ran:
```
# temporary policy to allow fallback
curl -XPOST https://console.redwood/api/routing -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","fallbacks":["model-quant-v2"],"rollout":"immediate"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED'
```
deploy-bot: ACTION: Canary rollback initiated for commit abcdef. Rolling back 3 canary pods.
Ravi Gupta: Good. Also paging note: if we don't see queue_wait reduce below 500ms within 10m, escalate to infra-lead and DBL for capacity commit. Page list: infra-lead -> oncall-manager -> CTO-oncall.
Maya Patel: Acknowledged. I'll monitor for 10m. Primary stays assigned to me; Samir you are secondary for this incident. Lin, can you verify APAC node labels and uncordon if safe?
Lin Zhao: On it — will uncordon the two nodes after a quick health probe. ETA 3m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Samir Khan: After fallback routed, I'm running a smoke grep for 200s across the model endpoints. If we still see 5xx, we'll failover to legacy-serve cluster.
Maya Patel: Update 3m in: queue_wait dropped to ~450ms, 502/503 rate down 80%. Traffic back to normal range. No customer-facing errors in SLO window yet.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: Severity holding. P2 -> monitoring. Next automated update in 15m.
Ravi Gupta: If this holds, we can keep current mitigations. Postmortem will want timeline: cause = node maintenance + deploy node selector mismatch, mitigation = fallback routing + canary rollback + uncordon.
Maya Patel: Agreed. I'll start a short runbook note in #postmortems after shift. Quick checklist before I hand off in 30m:
• confirm autoscaler bringing healthy nodes
• ensure fallback routing stays enabled until autoscaler stable
• add runbook pointer: https://wiki.redwood.internal/oncall/runbooks/batching-knee
• notify support to hold CS responses as "mitigated, monitoring"
Samir Khan: I'll stay on standby as secondary and watch the bridge. Ping me if latency climbs or if we need to page infra-lead.
Lin Zhao: APAC nodes uncordoned and healthy. Labels fixed to node.pool=dedicated-gpu.
Maya Patel: Great. Closing the bridge in 10m if no regressions. I'll hand off primary to Samir at 16:00 UTC.
Samir Khan: Copy that. I'll take primary at 16:00 UTC. Leaving note: if pager fires again, first escalation rule is to page infra-lead after 15 minutes; if it's customer-impacting (5+ customers), escalate immediately.
Maya Patel: Thanks team. Leaving final handoff note: primary=Maya (until 16:00), secondary=Samir, bridge=https://meet.redwood/incident/INC-8243, runbook=https://wiki.redwood.internal/oncall/runbooks/batching-knee :spiral_note_pad:
file_note: generated for on-call midday switchboard reroute coordination
